text: September 2026: we cleaned the exterior windows on a new build in Palm Beach. Dried splatter speckled the glass and frames, and plastic wrap and tape still surrounded them. We removed the wrapping, washed the glass and frames, did the outside of the louvres, and left the glass clear.
alt: A round patch of the right pane has been cleaned and sudsed, next to the still-dirty glass around it in Palm Beach
